cohort: 57 pregnancies in 48 patients who underwent therapeutic apheresis (TA) at the Apheresis Unit of the University Hospital of Padua between January 2005 and August 2017
finding: Therapeutic apheresis (TA) during pregnancy was well tolerated with a low rate of adverse events.
gest_age: Median gestational age at beginning of treatments was 21 weeks, median gestational age at delivery was 35 weeks
